svg.title: Procession: Photocopied punk-zine collage
svg.desc: Procession (2D): the cult's march as a photocopied punk-zine collage, black toner on grey paper, figures cut out and pasted in rows, banners in ransom-note letters, staples and strips of tape, toner streaks down the page. The march moves left to right; Dr. Tox in his shroud is pasted in near the rear as a red tape arrow points him to the front banner. Around him the ring of his breath is a torn white circle, and followers reach into it on purpose. A raised hand stops a few. A column strip along the top shows the whole march and his place in it; the Pulse line runs along the bottom.
